items.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
items.summary: OpenAI has announced a significant price reduction for its GPT-5.6 models, with Terra receiving a 20% decrease and Luna seeing an 80% drop. These changes are part of efforts to improve the cost-effectiveness of deploying AI workflows at scale. The reduction allows enterprises to leverage more efficient models without a proportional increase in costs, facilitating broader AI adoption.
